title: One-Dimensional Fermi Gas with Attractive Interaction
exact_target: Determine the long-distance one-particle correlations of a weakly attractive one-dimensional spinful Fermi gas.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7800007 (AMR-077-0007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Giovanni Gallavotti, original contribution to Open Problems in Mathematical Physics (1998), edited by Michael Aizenman.

status_qualification: The catalogue target is the one-dimensional spinful gas. The source additionally discusses strip and two-row lattice variants as related first steps, without identifying them with this canonical record. Smooth finite-range potentials are mentioned as a context for known perturbative results, not imposed as a replacement for the original target.
